sources.title: Dynamic Q
sources.snippet: Running modern Large Language Models (LLMs) like Qwen on a standard laptop or desktop relies on model compression techniques, efficient parameter architectures, and specialized local inference runtimes. These methods drastically reduce memory and compute requirements with minimal loss in reasoning, coding, and language capabilities.
